title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
sourceTitle: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
synopsis: Minas Tirith burns. Two hobbits climb Mount Doom. Every blade of grass between matters.

nodes.text: The signal fire is unlit and the steward forbids it.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Light it anyway.” The story records the instinct as “Defiance” and carries it forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Loyal.

nodes.text: Denethor offers a small sword and a long oath.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honor.
You commit to “Hesitate.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: A door in the mountain, and behind it, an army of oathbreakers.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Enter.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Ride the long road.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Osgiliath is lost. Denethor orders a doomed cavalry charge.

choices.consequence: “Ride” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Duty.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: A young rider with hidden hair offers Merry a place at her stirrup.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Go with her” back. Heart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Practical.

nodes.text: Sam hears Frodo scream past the webbing.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Run in” back. Loyal shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Fetch sting first.” The story records the instinct as “Smart” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Gollum whispers that the fat one stole the bread.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Trusting.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wary.

nodes.text: The steward calls for oil and a torch over his sleeping son.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Brave—follows you into whatever comes next.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Focused—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Dawn, and six thousand spears at the edge of the Pelennor.

choices.consequence: “Charge first rank” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Glory.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Discipline.

nodes.text: No man can kill him, he laughs. Eowyn answers with her helm in her hand.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Brave.
You commit to “Distract with Merry's blade.” The story records the instinct as “Cunning” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: A herald rides out with Frodo's mithril shirt swinging from a chain.

choices.consequence: “Believe him” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Hope.

nodes.text: The host of the West is a coin tossed into the dark.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Stand at front.” The story records the instinct as “Lead” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Stand with Pippin” back. Friend shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Frodo cannot walk. The mountain is still there.

choices.consequence: “Carry him” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Love.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Stern.

nodes.text: Frodo at the edge slips the ring onto his own finger.

choices.consequence: “Tackle him” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Desperate.
“Wait for Gollum” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Fated.

nodes.text: Wings against the smoke, far off.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Hope.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Peace—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: A clearing, a banner, a song you do not yet recognize is yours.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.
“Kneel” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Humble.

nodes.text: A sapling unfolds in the courtyard of Minas Tirith for no clear reason.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Hope.
“Let it grow wild” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Trust.

nodes.text: Aragorn bows to the hobbits. The whole city follows.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Equal—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Stand straight.” The story records the instinct as “Proud” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The Green Dragon is loud with strangers who do not know your name.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Quiet.
“Walk past” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Changed.

nodes.text: The kettle. The book. A page left blank for someone else.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.
“Leave it blank” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Humble.

nodes.text: A ship at the quay, and Gandalf already aboard.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Mercy.
There is no taking “Stay on the dock” back. Home shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You ride home to the Shire white-haired and quiet, and tend a garden that no enemy can find. The crown was Aragorn's; the long second life is yours.
You board the ship, and the sea air mends what Mordor broke. Somewhere ahead, a green country.
You leave the book open on the table for the next small hand. The story keeps going without you, which is the proof it was good.
